label: Alfheim starter kit
description: Original table-companion flavor seeds for a first session in the elf lands. No rulebook text — homebrew flavor only.

loot.name: Moonwell Vial
loot.bonus: Reroll one effort roll per session
loot.description: Water from a hidden spring, still glowing faintly at dusk.

loot.name: Elfbone Whistle
loot.bonus: Call your mount once per session
loot.description: Carved from a shed antler. Elves find it charming; everyone else finds it loud.

loot.name: Witchlight Ember
loot.bonus: Light on demand, never burns out
loot.description: An ember wrapped in waxed cloth that never quite goes out.

loot.name: Ruins Map Fragment
loot.bonus: Reveals one site on the world map
loot.description: A corner of some older map, the ink still sharp where the blood dried.

loot.name: Sergeant's Signet
loot.description: Warm to the touch, like a handshake that hasn't let go.
